persistent.description: Reuse the container across sessions instead of creating a fresh one

storage_pool.description: Incus storage pool to use for this container

alias.description: Human-readable alias for the workspace container

shutdown_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for graceful shutdown before force-killing (default: 60)

ready_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a launched container to become ready (default: 30)

stale_base_check.description: How to react when the project image's base is older than the current coi base: 'error' aborts, 'warn' prints a warning (default), 'off' is silent

session_name.description: Name that keys the session identity (container, slots, ports, saved sessions) instead of the workspace path, so the same persistent session continues from any workspace location. Honored from trusted scope only.

docker.description: Enable Docker/nested-container support (security.nesting, mknod/setxattr syscall interception, unprivileged low-port sysctl). Default: true. Set false to shrink the shared-kernel attack surface when Docker-in-container is not needed. Re-enabling (true) is honored from trusted scope only; false is a tightening and honored from any scope.

keep_on_failed_save.description: Keep a stopped non-persistent container when saving its session data fails (e.g. disk full) instead of deleting it, so 'coi shell --resume=<session id>' (the id coi prints) can save it later. Default: false.
